source_scope: Thesis model drawings exported from SolidWorks; dimensions in millimetres; structural piece thickness 3 mm stated in introduction.
Original AutoCAD files described as 1:1 millimetres; this does not make PDF pixels aircraft FS/BL/WL coordinates.
visual_observations: Sheet3 is a structural assembly plan showing beams, ribs, wing connectors and pivot holes.
Opposite wings are drawn at different sweep positions; 807.15 and 576.05 dimensions cannot be summed as a symmetric wingspan datum.
Visible framework and connector plates do not define a closed exterior glove surface.
No explicit aircraft FS/BL/WL datum labels observed on this reviewed sheet.
allowed_use: Study structural architecture and possible relative feature correspondences with explicit model-scale registration.
disallowed_inference: Do not inflate current body to cover rootbridge concept using this skeleton as an aircraft exterior skin.
Do not transfer a PDF sheet scale or structural thickness directly into the RC FDM airframe.
Do not use visible pivot holes alone as independent original-aircraft pivot/WL proof.
